blocks.h2: Water Treatment Options for Elmhurst Homes

tiles.body: Less scale on fixtures, glass and in the water heater.
Less chlorine taste and smell at every tap.

bodies: We test hardness, chlorine and sediment at your tap and explain the results in plain English.

Elmhurst's water is Lake Michigan water from the DuPage Water Commission, and the city reports hardness at about 8 grains per gallon. For health-related testing, a state-certified lab can run a full panel, and we'll point you to one.

blocks.h2: Sizing a Softener for an Elmhurst Home
blocks.body: A softener is sized by how hard your water is and how much your household uses. At around 8 grains per gallon, a family of four uses a softener that removes a lot of minerals every week. Too small, and it regenerates constantly, wasting salt and water. Too large, and it costs more than it needs to. We test, ask about your household and size it properly.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Water Treatment
blocks.body: An under-sink filter is the simplest install. Reverse osmosis adds a tank and a dedicated faucet. A softener or whole-house filter goes on the main line and needs a drain and an outlet nearby. The size of your home and your water use affect the equipment. We test first, then price the system that fits.

blocks.h2: Water Softener Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.answer: Yes. The city reports about 8 grains per gallon, which counts as hard water. That's enough to build scale in heaters and on fixtures.

items.preview: Many Elmhurst homeowners find it worth it.
items.answer: It depends on what bothers you. If scale, spotting or a noisy water heater are problems, a softener helps.

items.q: Does a softener make the water salty?
items.answer: Softened water has a small amount of added sodium. If that's a concern, a reverse osmosis filter at the kitchen sink removes most of it.

items.q: How often does a softener need salt?
items.answer: Usually every month or two, depending on use.

items.q: Will a softener help my water heater last longer?
items.answer: It can. Softer water means less sediment and scale.

items.q: Do I need a drain for a softener?
items.answer: Yes. It needs a nearby drain and an outlet. Most basements have both.

items.q: How much does a water softener cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the system. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the system and the installation. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we install.
